segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func initialAnimationVelocity(for gestureVelocity: CGPoint, from currentPosition: CGPoint, to finalPosition: CGPoint) -> CGVector { var animationVelocity = CGVector.zero let xDistance = finalPosition.x - currentPosition.x let yDistance = finalPosition.y - currentPosition.y if xDistance != 0 { animationVelocity.dx = gestureVelocity.x / xDistance } if yDistance != 0 { animationVelocity.dy = gestureVelocity.y / yDistance } return animationVelocity } ```
